newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CADSCHWEP SEES SHR GROWTH BUT TOUGH TRADING.
newsitem.headline: CADSCHWEP SEES SHR GROWTH BUT TOUGH TRADING.

text.p: Food and beverage group Cadbury Schweppes (South Africa) Ltd said on Tuesday it expected real earnings growth this year although trading conditions may be more difficult than in 1996.

"Although longer term prospects for the economy appear to be improving, the trading environment for 1997 could be more difficult than that of last year given the continued pressure on consumer spending," the group said in a statement.
CadSchwep on Tuesday announced financial results for the year ended December 28, 1996 showing earnings up 24.2 percent at 345.2 cents a share on turnover of 1.33 billion rand up from 1.13 a year ago.

The group said despite potentially tough conditions this year, it was well positioned to take advantage of growth opportunities due to its high quality brands and the strategic balance of its business.
"As a consequence, satisfactory real growth in earnings is expected to be achieved," it said.
